nodes.name: Upsert contact by email
nodes.notes: PATCH-by-email creates or updates in one call, so re-pushing the same person never makes a duplicate.

nodes.name: Is there a draft?
nodes.notes: No trigger, no draft. The app only attaches one when a rule says something happened.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), hs_email_direction: 'DRAFT_EMAIL', hs_email_status: 'DRAFT', hs_email_subject: $('Shape the payload').first().json.draft.subject, hs_email_html: $('Shape the payload').first().json.draft.body.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim()).map(l => '

' + l + '

').join('') }, associations: [{ to: { id: $('One item per note').first().json.contactId }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 198 }] }] }) }}

nodes.name: Create the draft email
nodes.notes:
A draft, never a sent email. hs_email_status DRAFT and direction DRAFT_EMAIL are real options, confirmed by creating one in the test portal rather than trusting docs. hs_email_to_email is READ ONLY and cannot be set here: HubSpot fills the recipient from the association. Blank lines in the plain text are paragraph breaks, and an empty

renders as a stray gap, so they are dropped and the paragraph spacing does the work. Association 198 is email-to-contact. Nothing in this flow can send.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, contactId: $('One item per note').first().json.contactId, notes: ($('Shape the payload').first().json.notes || []).length, draft: !!$('Shape the payload').first().json.draft }) }}
